guidance: Choose a version explicitly. Paths match displayed versions: v0 is legacy and v1 is current. The scores are not directly comparable. Previously published versioned URLs are not maintained or redirected.

v0.description: Legacy V0 with broader historical model coverage. Available benchmark scores are equally weighted; missing scores are excluded rather than treated as zero.

v1.description: Current V1: clean-v1 reruns and updated evaluation sets, currently tested on fewer frontier models. The overall view requires complete coverage and uses configured evaluation-count weights.

provenance.description: V2 score arrays in src/App.tsx, checked against the per-evaluation files in public/data/v1/. BioSecBench-Refusal scores come from public/data/v1/refusalbench.json. Overall weights come from public/data/aggregate-leaderboard.json. OncologyBench strict results use the selected 25 evaluations in the October 2 export, nine of them re-graded against a new decision rubric in the October 9 export, generated by scripts/build-oncologybench.mjs, plus the two Meta Muse configurations added on October 19 and Mistral Large 4.0 Preview and Inception Mercury 3 added on October 20. Mistral Large 4.0 Preview (Pi) on every capability board comes from the October 13-15 copy-environment re-runs.
